archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.name: 3 Data Editing and Enrichment Value Stream
archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.documentation:
Purpose: To improve the accuracy, completeness, and internal consistency of datasets through validation, correction, and enrichment processes.
Description: At this stage, value is created by enhancing data reliability and usability. Activities include error detection, imputation of missing data, derivation of new variables, and correction of inconsistencies or non-response. The goal is to maximize the analytical value of the dataset while maintaining transparency and traceability of transformations.
The resulting artefact — an edited and enriched dataset — represents data that has been cleansed, quality-checked, and enhanced, ready for statistical estimation or modeling.
Key capabilities: Data Quality Management, Data Editing, Imputation & Derivation, Non-response Correction, Data Validation & Verification.

children.content: To detect and correct errors, fill gaps, and derive new variables, improving the accuracy and completeness of data.
